events.title: Canadian Multiculturalism day
events.description: It promotes understanding and appreciation among Canadians of all backgrounds through cultural events and activities. On this significant day, Canada honors the rich cultures, languages, and contributions of First Nations, Inuit, and Métis peoples.

events.title: Indigenous History Month
events.description: June is National Indigenous History Month in Canada, an opportunity to learn about the unique cultures, traditions and experiences of First Nations, Inuit and Métis. It's a time to honour tesilience of Indigenous Peoples, who have lived on this land since time immemorial and whose presence continues to impact the evolving Canada.

events.title: Filipino Heritage Month
events.description: Filipino Heritage Month is observed in Canada during the month of June to recognize, celebrate and raise awareness about the Filipino community in Canada and their valuable contributions throughout Canadian history.This month acknowledges the long and rich history of Filipino Canadians and their contributions to Canada.

events.title: Pride month
events.description: June is Lesbian, Gay, Bisexual, and Transgender Pride Month, established to recognize the impact that gay, lesbian, bisexual and transgender individuals have had on the world. All In is the official theme for The Pride Toronto 2025 Festival!

events.title: Father's day
events.description: Father's Day is a special occasion dedicated to honoring the men who have played a vital role in shaping our lives. Fathers are often the quiet pillars of strength, providing guidance, protection, and unwavering support through every stage of our journey

events.title: World Refugee Day
events.description: The occasion would be a chance to reflect on “the courage and tenacity of migrants and refugees, who bear daily witness to hope in the future.”“often contributing to revitalising their faith and promoting interreligious dialogue based on common values.

events.title: National Indigenous Peoples Day
events.description: National Indigenous Peoples Day, observed annually on June 21 in Canada, is a day to recognize and celebrate the rich cultures, traditions, languages, knowledge, and contributions of First Nations, Inuit, and Métis Peoples.

events.title: International Yoga Day
events.description: The countdown to June 21 has begun! Start now. Breathe deep. Move mindfully. Today, let us celebrate this ancient practice that enhances our mental and physical well-being.  Happy International Yoga Day! Yoga holds profound benefits for both body and mind, fostering strength, flexibility, and tranquility
